# The llcommon integration tests that run under ThreadSanitizer: threaded, and without coroutines.
# Boost.Fiber is prebuilt without TSan fibre annotations, so a test that switches fibres (lleventcoro, llcond,
# workqueue, llleap, llprocess, llcoproc*) would report races that are not there; leave those out.
llmainthreadtask
threadsafeschedule
llsingleton
lltrace
